verdict.rationale: Figma Make is operated through chat. First-party docs describe running chats that make changes, giving the agent instructions via annotations, adding marked-up areas to prompts, and having it build a plan before generation. A community commenter confirms its AI writes React code in response to use. missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of the core prompt-to-app flow, and hands-on independent reports on how reliably natural-language commands are executed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can run more than one chat at the same time in a single Make file, so you can start a new change while another chat is still working.
